A fun, cute game that doesn't take to long to complete. Bosses were a good time and the designs were interesting - I like how most bosses do something a little different. I like that you can potentially alter your build to include whatever upgrades you'd like - even all of them if you do enough grinding! However, I never felt overpowered for any encounters and the bosses were scaled pretty well - as long as you learned the patterns, you could do it.
Addicting gameloop, challenging and rewarding. One of the greats, love this game.
Controls on PC are a little wonky, PS5 controller doesn't work (at least for me). But overall the game is super fun.

Solid game. They wrote the formula yet still keep adding new content.
You start each run collecting weapons and items; the run lasts 30 mins if you survive til the end.
Thats it. The items and their combos that have been added just keep piling up.

Worth every cent. Guaranteed

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.

A controversial remaster. The combat system and visuals have been improved, but the blindingly bright sunlight is genuinely unpleasant, and the new “Yoda-style lightsabers” from the updated combat effects look completely out of place in The Witcher 3.

These effects seriously hurt the visual atmosphere for me. I would like to see proper options to disable the glowing sword effects and tone down the excessive brightness.

I am leaving a negative review until these issues are addressed. The underlying game is still The Witcher 3, but these new visual choices make the remaster worse for me.
Short but fun metroidvania. Loved the artstyle. The controls feel nice and smooth. The boss battles were a bit on the easy side for me. Would recommend to pick is up when in sale!

Excellent batch of action and horror, neatly fused together into a delightful adventure, with great freedom to walk your own path along the road to saving the day.
Plenty of tools, plenty of choices, plenty of nooks, and plenty of winding roads to lose yourself in exploration.
Don't be like me and ignore it for years; Get to it, it's a fantastic experience.
